name: B10-0134/2025 (S&D) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Nicaragua's government for jailing and exiling opponents, human rights defenders, religious leaders and journalists. It asks Nicaragua to release all political prisoners, stop closing independent groups and media, let exiles return and give back seized property. It also asks the European Union and its member states to support detained people and those forced out, and welcomes Spain's offer of citizenship to exiles.

- The report is an opinion; it changes no law. It targets Nicaragua's government and EU member states.
- Nicaragua is asked to free prisoners, reopen closed groups and media, and return seized assets.
- The EU is asked to fund support for detainees and exiles; no next steps are set out.
